review_comments_data.body:
@lebaphi - do you know the reason for the above change?

All PouchDB documents have an `_id` field, so the `Reference` will never get used.  I _think_ the previous way was the correct way around.

comments.body:
Hello @lebaphi  - I've had a separate report for issues with the unread message count. 

Could you provide a description of what the issue is here? Then we'll know if it's a duplicate or not.  Thanks :-)

Hi @IanMayo , this issue is when we expand message in the table, the unread message count on the header minus one, but it's just a counter variable, not calculated by the total number of unread messages of the channel, refresh page the variable's value will become to the initial value, also the flag `hasBeenRead` of read message is still false.
